description: Found while fixing turnkey-vnm.22. solidity_library's compile action still reads soldeps through the literal cell path (read_root_config cells.soldeps + remappings.txt), so OpenZeppelin/forge-std sources are not inputs of the build action: changing a soldeps package doesn't rebuild dependents. solidity_test now depends on soldeps//:bundle instead; solidity_library should do the same (the bundle target and the macro pattern already exist in the solidity prelude extension).
title: solidity_library compiles soldeps sources it doesn't declare
